:::{#exr-kl-curvature}
#### Second derivative of the divergence

Under the assumptions of @exr-kl-slope,
show that the second derivative of the divergence of @def-model-kl-divergence is

$$
\dderiv{\param} \kldivf{\param_0}{\param}
= \Expp_{\param_0}\sb{-\hess(\param)},
$$

where $\hess(\param)$ is the [Hessian](#def-hessian) of the log-likelihood evaluated at $\param$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-kl-curvature}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\dderiv{\param} \kldivf{\param_0}{\param}
&= \deriv{\param} \paren{-\Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\score(\param)}}
&& \text{(@sol-kl-slope)}\\
&= -\Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\deriv{\param} \score(\param)}
&& \text{(exchange derivative and expectation)}\\
&= -\Expp_{\param_0}\sb{\hess(\param)}
&& \text{(the Hessian is the derivative of the score)}\\
&= \Expp_{\param_0}\sb{-\hess(\param)}
&& \text{(move the sign inside the expectation)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
